title: Only KI5: Vehicle Spawn & Livery Overhaul
description:
[h1]Only KI5: Vehicle Spawn & Livery Overhaul[/h1]
Put KI5 on Kentucky's roads. Regional police, military checkpoints and roadside scenes.

[hr][/hr]
[h2]How it works[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]KI5 traffic.[/b] Replaces vanilla traffic, profession vehicles and roadside vehicle choices.
[*] [b]Local police.[/b] Regional liveries for Louisville, Muldraugh, West Point and other jurisdictions.
[*] [b]Silent lightbars.[/b] Eligible police spawns have a 50% flashing-light chance outside emergency parking. Lights on, siren off, in single-player and multiplayer.
[*] [b]Military encounters.[/b] Military zones, checkpoint fleets and four roadside stories with consistent camo.
[*] [b]More variety.[/b] Integrated vehicle variants, police skins and duplicate suppression.
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Requirements[/h2]
[b]Build 42.21[/b], damnlib and More Car Features / WayMoreCars.

Install and enable the vehicles from the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=2490220997]KI5 collection[/url] before this mod. Vehicle packs are installed separately and are not individual Workshop requirements here.

[b]YAPZLib is not required.[/b] Internal helpers replace it.

[b]Highly recommended:[/b] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3808100388]KI5 Vehicle Performance Patch (Unofficial)[/url] by lucygoosey. Optional; follow its server/client setup instructions.

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Compatibility & saves[/h2]
Changes appear in [b]fresh chunks[/b]; existing vehicles are not rewritten. Back up saves before changing mods.

Disable standalone MCV, Consistent Camo, police skins/B42 hotfix, VMZ, No Vanilla selection mods and the old Vehicle Suite integrations: their selected content is already included.

[b]0.3.1 unlisted test release.[/b] Single-player, two-client multiplayer, silent lightbars and save/reload have been checked. Further acceptance testing continues.

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Credits[/h2]
[list]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=2490220997]KI5[/url] - original vehicles; external packs retain their creators' ownership.
[*] KI5 and bikinihorst - [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3171167894]damnlib[/url].
[*] GamestaMechanic - [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3520758551]More Car Features[/url].
[*] Пупсич - [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3455267136]More Car Variants[/url] and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3436499337]Vehicle Military Zones[/url]. VMZ's original [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3624971238]YAPZLib[/url] requirement is replaced here; no library source is bundled.
[*] Branco - [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3309256818]Consistent Camo[/url]; Papa_Chad - supported vehicle families.
[*] Old Killer - [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3395145553]Police Skins[/url].
[*] Kraz - [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2535461640]No Vanilla Vehicles[/url] selection inspiration and duplicate-ID data.
[/list]

If an original author reaches out, their integrated content will be removed and their mod moved to an external dependency, with credits retained. MIT covers authored contributions only; integrated content retains its original ownership.

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Info[/h2]
AI was used in the process to make this mod. If you have a problem with that, don't download it.
